sentences.text: Present petition under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. / 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed for correction in the order dated 05.2.2024 passed in MCRC No. 4350/2024.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that due to typographical mistake, in the order dated 05.2.2024 passed in MCRC No. 4350/2024, whereby anticipatory bail was granted to the petitioner,
"Crime No.", "Police Station" and "Sections of offences" have wrongly been mentioned, therefore,
prayed for correction in the same.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and perused the impugned order.

It appears that due to typographical mistake, in the first para of the impugned order, "Crime No.",
"Police Station" and "Sections of offences"
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22048 2 MCRC-53411-2024 have wrongly been mentioned.

Therefore, first para is modified as under"

sentences.text:
"This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 438 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of anticipatory bail relating to FIR No.614 of 2023 registered at Police Station - Chachoda, District - Guna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 366, 376(D), 506,
and 509 of IPC."
Rest of the order dated 05.2.2024 passed in MCRC No. 4350/2024 shall remain intact.
This order shall be read conjointly with the order dated 05.2.2024 passed in MCRC No. 4350/2024.
Present petition is disposed of accordingly.
